legend: Each employee of the "Blake Techologies" company uses a special messaging app "Blake Messenger". All the stuff likes this app and uses it constantly. However, some important futures are missing. For example, many users want to be able to search through the message history. It was already announced that the new feature will appear in the nearest update, when developers faced some troubles that only you may help them to solve.

All the messages are represented as a strings consisting of only lowercase English letters. In order to reduce the network load strings are represented in the special compressed form. Compression algorithm works as follows: string is represented as a concatenation of n blocks, each block containing only equal characters. One block may be described as a pair (li, ci), where li is the length of the i-th block and ci is the corresponding letter. Thus, the string s may be written as the sequence of pairs ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/68dc87dc42fc8b5c9e100569fb0db6d0de6f0e20.png).

Your task is to write the program, that given two compressed string t and s finds all occurrences of s in t. Developers know that there may be many such occurrences, so they only ask you to find the number of them. Note that p is the starting position of some occurrence of s in t if and only if tptp + 1...tp + |s| - 1 = s, where ti is the i-th character of string t.

Note that the way to represent the string in compressed form may not be unique. For example string "aaaa" may be given as ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/939322623808439da25353cdf333633a2bd459d1.png), ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1d6356300e6949063b637098187983ab4a94bdd0.png), ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fe55bc3160319d1cb679fcb8d1a2d90686d4db05.png)...
input: The first line of the input contains two integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 200 000) — the number of blocks in the strings t and s, respectively.
The second line contains the descriptions of n parts of string t in the format "li-ci" (1 ≤ li ≤ 1 000 000) — the length of the i-th part and the corresponding lowercase English letter.
The second line contains the descriptions of m parts of string s in the format "li-ci" (1 ≤ li ≤ 1 000 000) — the length of the i-th part and the corresponding lowercase English letter.
output: Print a single integer — the number of occurrences of s in t.
note: In the first sample, t = "aaabbccccaaacc", and string s = "aabbc". The only occurrence of string s in string t starts at position p = 2.
In the second sample, t = "aaabbbbbbaaaaaaacccceeeeeeeeaa", and s = "aaa". The occurrences of s in t start at positions p = 1, p = 10, p = 11, p = 12, p = 13 and p = 14.

legend.ai: “Blake Techologies”公司的每位员工都使用一款名为“Blake Messenger”的特殊即时通信应用。所有员工都喜欢这款应用，并且一直在使用它。然而，这款应用还缺少一些重要功能。例如，许多用户希望能够搜索消息历史记录。开发者已经宣布，新功能将在最近的一次更新中推出，但他们遇到了一些问题，只有你能帮助他们解决。

所有消息都表示为仅由小写英文字母组成的字符串。为了减少网络负载，字符串采用特殊的压缩形式表示。压缩算法如下：字符串表示为 n 个块的拼接，每个块中只包含相同的字符。一个块可以表示为一对 (li, ci)，其中 li 是第 i 个块的长度，ci 是对应的字母。因此，字符串 s 可以写成如下的序列 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/68dc87dc42fc8b5c9e100569fb0db6d0de6f0e20.png)。
你的任务是编写一个程序，给定两个压缩字符串 t 和 s，找出 s 在 t 中的所有出现位置。开发者知道这样的出现可能有很多，因此只要求你求出它们的数量。注意，当且仅当 tptp + 1...tp + |s| - 1 = s 时，p 才是 s 在 t 中某次出现的起始位置，其中 ti 是字符串 t 的第 i 个字符。

注意，同一个字符串的压缩表示方式可能不唯一。例如，字符串 "aaaa" 可以表示为 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/939322623808439da25353cdf333633a2bd459d1.png)、![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1d6356300e6949063b637098187983ab4a94bdd0.png)、![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fe55bc3160319d1cb679fcb8d1a2d90686d4db05.png)……

output.ai: 输出一个整数——s 在 t 中出现的次数。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，t = "aaabbccccaaacc"，字符串 s = "aabbc"。字符串 s 在字符串 t 中唯一一次出现的起始位置为 p = 2。
在第二个样例中，t = "aaabbbbbbaaaaaaacccceeeeeeeeaa"，s = "aaa"。s 在 t 中的出现位置为 p = 1、p = 10、p = 11、p = 12、p = 13 和 p = 14。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个整数 n 和 m（1 ≤ n，m ≤ 200 000），分别表示字符串 t 和 s 中块的数量。
第二行包含字符串 t 的 n 个部分的描述，格式为 "li-ci"（1 ≤ li ≤ 1 000 000），其中 li 是第 i 个部分的长度，ci 是对应的小写英文字母。
第二行包含字符串 s 的 m 个部分的描述，格式为 "li-ci"（1 ≤ li ≤ 1 000 000），其中 li 是第 i 个部分的长度，ci 是对应的小写英文字母。
